apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.3-beta+14

- PC player: separate volume and brightness boxes; controls stay after focus loss
  - Volume and brightness are now two separate boxes in the bottom bar, each growing upwards with its own slider on hover.
  - On PC, losing focus (another window clicked) counted as picture-in-picture: AnymeX hid every player control until the window was used again. Only phones do that now.
  - Focus log: also says who has focus 0.6 s and 2 s after AnymeX loses it, and when the player's controls and pointer hide (the loss comes 1–2 s after focus, about when they hide).
